title: Canonical client-mutation cache invalidation evidence
rootCause: The Clients page used raw client mutations and maintained a separate invalidation list containing the obsolete ['inventory'] key. InventoryView also repeated its own client-dependent invalidation list. Those bypasses could leave the canonical store, count, or inventory endpoint families stale after a successful client mutation.

verification.command: npm run build:web with inert Vite environment values
npm run test:sot-guard-pack with inert localhost/.invalid environment values and a dummy test JWT secret
verification.details: All 56 mandatory commands passed. An earlier attempt stopped before product behavior at the offline fixture's missing SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET precondition; the complete rerun passed after adding a dummy test-only value.
